reasons: Rule NOSOLICIT's preferred position is that no non-solicit binds the Customer; the cited paragraphs (§14.5 independent contractors and §13.5/Developments personnel warranty) contain no solicitation, hiring, recruiting or inducement restriction, so absence of such a covenant supports the compliant classification.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding, and the rendered redline is identical to the original text.

The failed deterministic checks (no duration, no general-solicitation carve-out) are consistent with there being no non-solicit clause at all rather than evidence of a deficient clause, so they do not undercut the verdict.
Rationale accurately notes the only personnel-related provisions (employee NDA/invention warranty and independent contractor language) impose no hiring restriction on Corio, the party we represent.
